name: web-forest-cover-slide-giant-leaf-title
title: Cosmetics store cover: giant LEAF title on a cream card over dark forest
whatItIs: A monochrome forest photograph with a cream rectangle in the centre. Inside, a huge sage-green 'LEAF' in light caps, a row of overlapping circles with tiny landscapes, a short Ukrainian tagline, and metadata labels in the corners.
whatItMeans: Calm, organic and premium; the cream card feels like a label set on nature.
techniques: Place a solid cream panel over a darkened photo to create a focused title area.
Set the brand name in enormous light caps in a muted green.
Use overlapping circles as a subtle motif.
Add tiny project metadata at the corners.

vocabulary.definition: A flat coloured rectangle laid over an image for text.
A row of intersecting round shapes as a motif.
A slide containing just the project name.
